Sentinel-3C has reached its operational orbit! 🎯

After launching on 15 September, the spacecraft is now flying in tandem with, Sentinel-3B, as teams at #ESOC continue preparing Sentinel-3C for routine operations. https://t.co/AoPcPg9eGY

@IBM announces IBM Quantum Nighthawk r3, a new processor to support 10k quantum operations on 520 programmable qubits. 

A new managed workflow experience on the IBM Quantum Platform brings classical and quantum compute together in a single environment: https://t.co/oUC6jukxAn https://t.co/3CA1DmsQoh

Launched in *2024*.

It's true, the valiant honorable work of people like me holding EAs' feet to the fire on this issue has, gradually, begrudgingly, kicking and screaming, led EA groups to allocate a portion of their funds to where they should have been focused since day 1. https://t.co/MJJuqIVVpm
Gonna be interesting to watch how things go in Florida https://t.co/iLFSoapzsN
Its always funny to me when people just aren’t in on the bit https://t.co/QNndUJCuAm

How’s that for a starburst?

Found in this distant spiral galaxy is a giant star prone to mysterious outbursts. Thanks to @ChandraXray, scientists identified the culprit behind the eruptions—a hidden companion to the volatile star. https://t.co/Q3J9uOmEVM https://t.co/bB3nIrowVZ

Science and medicine evolve, and so do the materials needed for medical treatments. NIST and @ENERGY are working with partners to recycle old medical materials so they can be made into targeted cancer therapies. 

Learn more: https://t.co/CktvZ1WhXt https://t.co/394zIGqPS2
